annotations.title: Prepare small company accounts to file in the browser

description: Works out the small company accounts from the open DIYA-GL book, as derive_small_company_accounts does, and answers a link to the small company accounts form on DIY Accounting Submit with the period, the profit and loss account, both years' balance sheets, the fixed asset note, the employee count and the directors filled in. The person opens the link, looks up the company, checks the figures, adds the accounting policies, the date approved and the statements, and files there with the company's authentication code. Use this when the person asks to file their small company accounts at Companies House. It never files anything and contacts no outside service.
name: prepare_small_company_accounts
